title: Short Semiconductor Stocks With These Two ETFs
主要内容: The semiconductor sector has been severely impacted by the U.S.-China trade war. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index declined 3.6% on Aug 5, marking the longest losing streak since October. The U.S. imposed a 10% tariff on $300 billion of Chinese goods, expected to rise beyond 25%, affecting smartphones, laptops, and clothing. China retaliated by devaluing the yuan and halting U.S. agricultural imports. Semiconductor companies like AMD, QCOM, WDC, and ON reported weak earnings and outlook, with ON experiencing its largest one-day drop since 2015. Global chip sales fell 16.8% YoY in June and 14.5% in H1 2019, according to the Semiconductor Industry Association. Gartner expects worldwide semiconductor revenues to drop 9.6% to $429 billion this year, citing a weaker pricing environment for memory and some other chips types, and lower growth in major applications including smartphones, servers and PCs. The iShares PHLX Semiconductor ETF (SOXX) pulled out nearly $162 million in a one-week period through Aug 2. The fund is down nearly 11% over the past five days.
